candidate.claim: Last path segment token is never assigned when the final slash is at index 0 because prevIndex is tested for truthiness instead of definedness, so scan('/a',{tokens:true}) leaves the trailing token empty and maxDepth under-counted.
candidate.title: Falsy prevIndex check drops leading-slash trailing token

verifier.reason: The loop sets prevIndex to the slash index at scan.js:382, and the final token assignment at scan.js:391-393 is guarded by the truthy check at scan.js:390, so for '/a' with its only slash at index 0 that assignment and maxDepth increment are skipped.
